result.root_cause: Application exited with non-zero status code 1 causing the container to repeatedly crash.
recommended_actions: Check application logs in detail to identify why the application is exiting with status code 1.
Verify that all required environment variables are set correctly for the application.
Ensure that any dependencies the application needs are available and healthy.
Validate the startup command and arguments configured for the container.

result.root_cause: Pod is in ImagePullBackOff status due to failure to pull the container image, likely caused by an incorrect image name, tag, or lack of access to the image repository.
recommended_actions: Verify the image name and tag specified in the pod spec are correct.
Check if the image repository requires authentication and ensure that proper imagePullSecrets are configured.
Verify network connectivity to the image registry.
Check registry status to ensure it is operational.
